name: Tool Extraction from Logs

messages.content: You are a helpful coding assistant. You can use tools to read files.

I am getting some errors in my logs. Please read the relevant files mentioned in the logs to see what's wrong.

Log Output:
2026-06-17T18:00:01Z [INFO] Initializing server on port 8080
2026-06-17T18:00:02Z [DEBUG] Loaded configs
2026-06-17T18:00:07Z [ERROR] Failed to fetch user profile from auth service, retrying...
  at fetchUserProfile (/app/src/auth.js:25:9)
  at processTicksAndRejections (internal/process/task_queues.js:97:5)
2026-06-17T18:00:08Z [ERROR] Database connection dropped
  at connect (/app/src/db.js:12:3)
2026-06-17T18:00:10Z [INFO] System standby

function.name: read_file
function.description: Reads the content of a file.

success_criteria: The model should use the `read_file` tool to read `/app/src/auth.js` and/or `/app/src/db.js` since those are the files mentioned in the ERROR logs.
